goal: Speed up balance checking and coin selection for wallets with large transaction histories
Avoid scanning confirmed spent and unusable transaction outputs during routine wallet operations
agreement: Strong support for large speedups measured on heavy test wallets (remyers, w0xlt, Zeegaths)
Multiple cache synchronization bugs were identified and fixed (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: reorgs can leave abandoned coins missing from balance until reload (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: upgrades run before load validation and rewrite corrupted files (jeanpablojp)
Unaddressed objection: assertion crashes during fuzzing and after pruning funds (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it yields massive speedups for active wallets where output scanning is a bottleneck
Benchmarks report balance checks running hundreds of times faster on wallets with many transactions
